description: This file defines an Android activity and a fragment that demonstrate how to display and handle a context menu within a fragment. The activity hosts the fragment which registers a view for a context menu and handles menu item selections.

classes.name: FragmentContextMenu
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating how to display a context menu from within a fragment.

classes.name: ContextMenuFragment
classes.description: A fragment that inflates a layout, registers a view for a context menu, and handles context menu creation and item selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the fragment to the activity's content view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and registers a view for the context menu.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates the context menu with two items when the user performs a long-press.

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of context menu items and shows corresponding toast messages.
